prompt:
A Binary Search Tree (BST) is constructed by sequentially inserting the following keys into an initially empty tree:
`[56, 28, 84, 14, 42, 70, 98]`

What is the exact **Postorder** traversal sequence of this tree?
explanation: Postorder traversal visits Left Subtree -> Right Subtree -> Root. Root 56 is processed last after all its children: [14, 42, 28, 70, 98, 84, 56].
